Howland wants the power to summon [[Ice Golem]]s and wants you to obtain [[the Heart of Ice]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = elementalist
}}

===Objectives===
* Find [[Greplak Froststaff]] and obtain the Heart of Ice from him.
* Deliver the Heart of Ice to Howland the Elementalist.
* Return to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.

===Reward===
* 350 [[Experience]]
* 75 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Whirlwind}}
* {{skill icon|Ward Against Foes}}
* {{skill icon|Ice Prison}}

==Walkthrough==
Follow the path on the map posted above to find Greplak. He can control Ice Golems, so when you get close to him he will try and summon more to defend himself with. All you have to do to finish this quest is talk to Greplak. He'll get scared and give you the Heart of Ice.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) 
*{{x}} 8 [[Greplak Froststaff]]

===Foes===
[[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) 
*{{e}} 10 [[Ice Golem]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Howland the Elementalist
:''"Greetings Elementalist. I have a proposition for you. The Stone Summit are able to create Ice Golems using a magical gem known as the '''Heart of Ice'''. I want it. Find '''Greplak Froststaff''' in '''Traveler's Vale''' and obtain it from him.''

:''Agreed?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Agreed.
| decline = I don't think so.
| ask = Obtain the '''Heart of Ice''' from '''Greplak Froststaff'''.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Greplak Froststaff:''' ''"You're after the Heart of Ice! You'll never have it! Never!"''
:'''Greplak Froststaff:''' ''"I su-surrender! Here t-take the damned thing!"''

;Greplak Froststaff
:''"You w-want the Heart of Ice? H-here, take it! Just d-don't hurt me!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Howland the Elementalist
:''"Ah, the Heart of Ice… Well done. Now leave me to my studies."''
